announcements.title: Check CCS adapter eligibility before sale
announcements.body: Confirm retrofit eligibility in the service portal before selling TSL-UN-CHG-0318. Vehicles built before 2020 may require a hardware retrofit.

announcements.title: Sport Pedal Set discontinued
announcements.body: TSL-M3-EXT-0420 is discontinued and cannot be ordered. Remaining floor stock may be sold at the listed price.

announcements.title: Delivery Day Kits are the current focus
announcements.body: Offer the matching Delivery Day Kit at every handover this quarter. Bundle pricing is already reflected in the catalogue.
